name: Stormbringer: Tome of Lightning rank 1 works natively (#1678)
contract: #1678 rank 1 (300606) has three effects: effect0 aura 232 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, EffectMiscValue 9 (MECHANIC_SILENCE), EffectBasePoints -21 + DieSides 1 = -20; effect1 aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, EffectBasePoints 1 + DieSides 1 = +2, unconditional; effect2 aura 232 again, EffectMiscValue 26 (MECHANIC_INTERRUPT), EffectBasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25. Aura 232 is a no-op handler; the mechanic is Unit::ModSpellDuration (Unit.cpp:12193-12225), which reduces the duration of an incoming NEGATIVE aura on the Stormbringer by GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, mechanic) - but this function is only reached from a real spell cast's target-duration resolution (Spell::EffectApplyAura path); Aura::CalcMaxDuration (used by both a real cast and the set_aura fixture action) calls only Unit::CalcSpellDuration (combo-point scaling), never Unit::ModSpellDuration, so a set_aura fixture cannot exercise this aura type at all (same limitation the Chronomancer Entropy Reversal scenario documents for aura 245) - proof requires casting a genuine Mechanic-9 debuff from a live attacker onto both an untalented control and the talented Stormbringer. Spell Lock's own applied debuff (24259, whole-spell Mechanic 9, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, single APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE effect, EffectImplicitTargetA TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY) is the fixture: SpellInfo::GetSpellMechanicMaskByEffectMask (SpellInfo.cpp:2113-2122) always ORs in the whole-spell Mechanic field regardless of per-effect Mechanic, so 24259 carries mechanic bit 9 even though its own EffectMechanic[0] is 0. No real spell in this DBC's Interrupt (26) family leaves a duration-bearing APPLY_AURA effect (Pummel/Kick/Counterspell/Mind Freeze/Wind Shear/Spell Lock's own SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST effect are all instant, no aura) - the -25% Interrupt clause cannot be proven with any existing spell and is not asserted here (see report). Rank 2 (706308) is NOT proven by this scenario and is classified needs_maintainer_decision, not works_natively: its Attributes field (384) lacks SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE and has Stances 0, so Player::_addSpell (Player.cpp:3384-3389, gated by SpellInfo::IsPassive, SpellInfo.cpp:1225-1228) never auto-casts its aura even once learned - HasSpell(706308) is true but no aura ever applies. It also has zero acquisition path anywhere in the client DBC (CharacterAdvancement/Talent/SkillLineAbility/Item/ItemSpells/SpellItemEnchantment all return no rows for 706308), unlike rank 1's own single-rank CharacterAdvancement entry (34673) which at least exists; a sibling entry (34674) proves the schema supports genuine multi-rank RankSpell chains, so this is not a tooling limitation. This looks like incomplete/lost DBC authoring rather than something to script around, so no fix is proposed; the finding is recorded for the maintainers. Rank 1 has no module code and closes as a regression scenario only. The fixture must spawn outside sanctuary: Unit::_IsValidAttackTarget (Unit.cpp:11428-11431) rejects a PvP attack whenever either the attacker or the target IsInSanctuary(), independent of faction, so the original spawn point (-8917.41, -115.853, 82.3711, the shared non-hostile fixture location used by hundreds of other scenarios) made the attacker's very first hostile cast fail with SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS (12) despite the attacker and the two Stormbringers being on opposite factions (caster_faction 1 vs target_faction 116, confirmed in result.json); moved to (-9617.06, -288.949, 57.3053), the location every other cross-faction hostile-PvP-cast scenario in this suite already uses (e.g. primalist-boulder-control.json, pyromancer-fix-880-gaze-of-ysera-pvp-duration.json). Aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT is unconditional and summed directly into Player::UpdateSpellCritChance (StatSystem.cpp:968-989) via GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE, SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT) with an always-true default predicate - no Player::ApplySpellMod/HasSpellModApplied gate is involved (unlike the #2801 Aethermancy rank 2 PCT spellmod case), so both ranks' crit-chance effects apply on every school without any core-side blocker; the crit0 baseline snapshot must be taken before rank 1 is learned, not after (the prior step order captured it two steps after the rank 1 learn step, so the DISCRIMINATING rank-1 delta assert always read a spurious 0 against itself - moved the snapshot ahead of the learn step, a scenario-ordering fix only, no code change).
